catalog.browser_fetch.label: Browse webpage
catalog.browser_fetch.description: Read a public webpage using the isolated browser runtime.
catalog.get_time_info.label: Current date and time
catalog.get_time_info.description: Get the server's current local date, time, timezone, UTC offset, and Unix timestamp.
catalog.eval_javascript.label: Run JavaScript
catalog.eval_javascript.description: Run a calculation in an isolated JavaScript context. No Node.js, filesystem, network, or DOM APIs are available.
catalog.fetch_url.label: Fetch webpage
catalog.fetch_url.description: Fetch a public HTTP or HTTPS URL and return readable text. Private and loopback addresses are blocked.
catalog.search_web.label: Search the web
catalog.search_web.description: Use action=list_engines to list available search services in recommended order. Use action=search (default) to search. Prefer earlier services unless another fits the task better. Omit engine_id to use the first available service. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.
catalog.image_generate.label: Generate images
catalog.image_generate.description: Use action=list_models to list available image models and readable model_id values in recommended order. Prefer earlier models unless another fits the task better. Use action=generate (default) with prompt and optional model_id to generate, edit, inpaint, or vary images. Omit model_id to use the first available model. Results are saved as image assets.
catalog.recent_chats.label: Recent conversations
catalog.recent_chats.description: List recent conversation titles and update times. Use conversation_search to read matching content.
catalog.conversation_search.label: Search conversations
catalog.conversation_search.description: Search the user's server-side conversation history for a focused text query.
catalog.memory_tool.label: Manage memory
catalog.memory_tool.description: Create, edit, or delete durable user memories. Avoid sensitive personal data and merge duplicates.
catalog.workspace_list.label: List files
catalog.workspace_list.description: List files and directories using paths relative to the conversation workspace root. Use . for the root; returned paths can be used directly by workspace file tools and shell commands.
catalog.workspace_read_file.label: Read file
catalog.workspace_read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file using a path relative to the conversation workspace root (maximum 8 MiB). The returned path is also workspace-relative.
catalog.workspace_write_file.label: Write file
catalog.workspace_write_file.description: Write a UTF-8 text file using a path relative to the conversation workspace root. The returned path is also workspace-relative.
catalog.workspace_edit_file.label: Edit file
catalog.workspace_edit_file.description: Replace exact text in a UTF-8 file using a path relative to the conversation workspace root. The returned path is also workspace-relative.
catalog.workspace_glob.label: Find files
catalog.workspace_glob.description: Find workspace-relative paths with a glob pattern such as **/*.ts. Returned paths can be used directly by workspace file tools and shell commands.
catalog.workspace_grep.label: Search file contents
catalog.workspace_grep.description: Search UTF-8 workspace files for plain text or a regular expression. Match paths are relative to the conversation workspace root and can be used directly by file tools and shell commands.
catalog.workspace_shell_readonly.label: Run read-only command
catalog.workspace_shell_readonly.descrip: Prefer this tool for local file reading, searching and analysis with shell pipelines, loops, or installed Node/Python scripts. Runs in a Linux sandbox with NO network. The conversation project is read-only at /workspace and attachments at /attachments. Select workspace and use a relative cwd (default .). Only /tmp is writable (64 MiB, erased after each call); return results through stdout. Other host user files are unavailable. Writes to project files fail; never automatically retry them with workspace_shell.
catalog.workspace_shell.label: Run shell command
catalog.workspace_shell.description: Run a shell command in the conversation workspace with user approval by default. Prefer workspace_shell_readonly for local reading, searching and analysis. This tool runs without the read-only sandbox. Use workspace-relative paths and . for the workspace root.
catalog.workspace_publish_image.label: Publish image
catalog.workspace_publish_image.descript: Import an image from the conversation workspace into immutable llm-chat storage and return a permanent Markdown image link. Use this before showing a machine-local image to the user.
catalog.workspace_publish_file.label: Publish file
catalog.workspace_publish_file.descripti: Import a file from the selected workspace into immutable llm-chat storage and return a permanent Markdown link. Publishing requires approval because it exposes machine-local data to the user.
catalog.use_skill.label: Load Skill
catalog.background_start.label: Start background task
catalog.background_start.description: Start a long-running command in the frozen conversation workspace and return its task id immediately. Use paths relative to the workspace root in the command.
catalog.background_list.label: List background tasks
catalog.background_list.description: List background tasks for this conversation.
catalog.background_status.label: Background task status
catalog.background_read.label: Read background output
catalog.background_read.description: Read incremental task output from a byte cursor. PTY tasks also return a terminal screen projection.
catalog.background_wait.label: Wait for background output
catalog.background_wait.description: Wait until output settles, task state changes, or timeout expires. Cancelling this call does not stop the task.
catalog.background_write.label: Write to background terminal
catalog.background_write.description: Send raw input to a running background task. A non-empty audit reason is required.
catalog.background_stop.label: Stop background task
catalog.background_stop.description: Stop a queued or running background task. A non-empty audit reason is required.
catalog.app_agents.label: Manage Agents
catalog.app_agents.description: List, inspect, create, update, import, export, set avatar, or delete llm-chat Agents. Character-card sources may be a current-conversation attachment, public URL, or selected workspace file.
catalog.app_conversations.label: Manage conversations
catalog.app_conversations.description: List, inspect, create, update, fork without generation, or select an existing response version. This tool never starts model generation or context summarization.
catalog.app_settings.label: App settings
catalog.app_settings.description: Read or update non-secret llm-chat settings. Generation settings belong to app_agents execution, including baseSystemPrompt. Login credentials are never available.
catalog.app_connections.label: Manage connections
catalog.app_connections.description: Manage non-secret connection fields, test a connection, query balance, or discover models. API keys and secret headers cannot be read or written.
catalog.app_models.label: Manage models
catalog.app_models.description: List, inspect, create, update, restore catalog defaults, or delete models.
catalog.app_mcp_servers.label: Manage MCP servers
catalog.app_mcp_servers.description: Manage and test MCP server definitions without exposing or changing secret headers.
catalog.app_skills.label: Manage Skills
catalog.app_skills.description: List, discover, install, or reload Skills. Skill removal is intentionally unavailable because sources may be externally managed.
catalog.app_plugins.label: Manage Plugins
catalog.app_plugins.description: List, install, configure non-secret fields, reload, unload, or remove managed plugins.
catalog.app_tool_settings.label: Tool settings
catalog.app_tool_settings.description: Read or update global tool enablement and workspace Shell state. Search settings belong to each Agent.
catalog.app_roleplay.label: Manage roleplay
catalog.app_roleplay.description: Inspect or update Agent-owned roleplay configuration and conversation roleplay state, run restricted STscript, or inspect its audit log. No arbitrary JavaScript, shell, or network execution is available.
catalog.search_tools.label: Find tools
catalog.search_tools.description: Search available tools and load matching tools for this conversation.
skill.command-execution-guide.name: Command Execution Guide
skill.command-execution-guide.descriptio: Complete concrete tasks using file tools, shell commands, and background tasks.
skill.llm-chat-operator.name: App Operator
skill.llm-chat-operator.description: Manage Agents, conversations, models, connections, and app settings.
skill.tool-author.name: Tool Author
skill.tool-author.description: Create and manage isolated ESM tool plugins.
